items.rationale: Surge damage is an insured event under 2.3.3. No surge protection is established, but the loss notification says nothing was on a protected strip, so the 50% reduction applies. References put a TV at about 590 and the policy halves it, giving about 300.
Damaged appliance covered under 2.3.3. The 50% unprotected-connection reduction applies. Reference speaker price is about 450, so half is about 225.
Physically damaged appliance, covered under 2.3.3 and subject to the 50% reduction. A standard-grade receiver costs about 450, so about 225 after the reduction.

items.description: Melted mains plug and power lead
items.rationale: Physically surge-damaged accessory, indemnifiable. The unprotected-strip reduction applies to accessories as well, so a small amount results.
Not shown to be physically damaged by the surge. 4.2.4 and 7.1.5 require established damage to the item, and 7.1.6 gives no extension to undamaged parts of a set.
A passive metal bracket is not an electrical appliance and was not damaged by the surge, so it is not an affected item.
Had been failing for months before the storm. This is wear and ageing, excluded under 2.3.10(c), so t=0.
No physical damage is established by the loss investigation (4.2.4, 7.1.5, 7.1.10), so the router is not an affected item.
Carriage of replacement property is not a repair cost under 7.1.8(b).
Fitting and setup of replacement property is excluded under 7.1.8(c).
The technician's own diagnostic and report is an outlay under 7.1.8(e) and the invoice is an arrangement under 3.1.4 and 3.1.5, so it is not a repair cost. References put this type of line at 0 to 6.
The invoice is not indemnifiable, so the attendance charge is not either under 7.1.8(d). A return visit is also a duplicate under 7.1.8(g).

items.description: Wiring safety check of distribution board
items.rationale: The check of undamaged building wiring is outside the affected items under 7.1.5 and is an inspection under 3.1.5.
Administrative and order-processing charges are excluded under 7.1.8(e) and 7.1.8(f).
Attendance charge on an invoice with no indemnifiable work, excluded under 7.1.8(d).
